chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id, from al-Qasim, from Aban ibn 'Uthman, from Abi Basir and Abi al-'Abbas al-Fadl ibn 'Abd al-Malik, from Abi 'Abd Allah عليه السلام, who said:
If a man catches one rak'ah, then he has caught the Jumu'ah prayer; but if it has escaped him, then let him pray four.

key_terms.أَدْرَكَ: caught up with or attained within the required time
key_terms.أَرْبَعًا: four rak'ahs, meaning the four-unit prayer in place of Jumu'ah
key_terms.فَاتَتْهُ: it passed him by or he failed to catch it
key_terms.فَلْيُصَلِّ: then he should perform the prayer

ai.seo_question: When does a person count as having caught the Jumu'ah prayer?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about catching the Friday prayer. If one reaches one rak'ah of Jumu'ah, it counts as having attained it; otherwise, he should perform four rak'ahs as the regular zuhr prayer.
